note: Voice > Register > SSML. A voice is a timbre (SID + optional neural blend) holding 3 registers. Register is the RENDER STATE (which register the engine is in when it synthesizes); it is set by set_render_register, not by markup. Each register's prosody is a RANGE envelope, not a scalar: break/emphasis/rate/lift are [min,max]. The SSML tag supplies a normalized intensity (emphasis reduced/moderate/strong = 0/0.5/1; rate x-slow..x-fast = 0..1; break by length; lift by pitch), and the delivered value = lerp(min,max,intensity). Same markup lands bigger in peak because peak's envelope is wider. A scalar is read as [s,s] (back-compat). Timbre knobs (kokoro_slot/speed/bright/gain/exaggeration) are per register; blend_slots true = neural blend (Isabella only), false = fixed SID + prosody/DSP. Edit here and re-run the bench; the tuner Registers tab edits the ranges.
